blocks.text: Project: site grading design for {{fact:f:E-2001-001.client}}. Subject: design coordination meeting for the Esparza-Lamb set. Prepared by Jason Jordan, Design Technician.

items: Debra Vasquez, Vice President of Finance, {{fact:f:E-2001-001.client}}

blocks.text: Linda Nguyen reported that the preliminary grading plans have advanced to the point where the finished elevations can be checked against the roadway profile, and it was agreed that the grading set and the roadway sheets should now be reviewed together, so that any conflict between the two is caught while it is still inexpensive to correct.

The drainage details were discussed at some length, and while the general scheme is settled, it was noted that two of the inlet callouts do not yet match the detail they reference, a discrepancy that will be corrected before the set is circulated again. Debra Vasquez asked that the review copy sent to the client be a clean, coordinated set rather than a working print, and that request was accepted without objection.

Jason Jordan raised two observations from the most recent site visit, the first being a low area along the eastern boundary that the current grading routes to the proposed inlet without difficulty, and the second a short run of existing grade near the entrance that will require a supplemental survey shot before the finished elevations there can be fixed. It was agreed that the supplemental shot would be requested, so that the entrance grading is set on measured ground rather than on an interpolation between two distant points.

On the standard details, it was confirmed that the border sheets and the detail library now in use are the current issue, so that no sheet in the set relies on a detail that has since been superseded. It was further observed that the coordination between the grading and roadway sheets is the item most likely to govern the pace of the coming weeks, and it was agreed to keep the two sets under joint review from this point forward.

The group reviewed the schedule against the work remaining and found the design to be progressing in line with the plan, with the coordinated review set identified as the next milestone and the client's comments on that set as the item most likely to determine the pace thereafter. A realistic window for the coordinated set will be confirmed once the inlet callouts and the entrance survey are resolved.

rows: Correct the inlet callouts to match the referenced details
Request the supplemental survey shot at the entrance
Coordinate the grading set against the roadway profile
Circulate the coordinated review set to the client
Return the client comments on the coordinated set

blocks.text: The next progress meeting will be set once the coordinated set is ready, and Linda Nguyen will circulate the corrected grading sheets to Debra Vasquez in advance, so that the meeting can be spent on comments rather than on a first reading of the set.
